edb7acc2-79c3-441d-9ba2-0009ff206bac/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> followed the storyteller closely into the valley.<NL>Upon stepping into the valley, the storyteller transformed—casting off his clothes with abandon like a wild horse freed from its reins.<NL>He hopped and shed his clothes joyfully,<NL>revealing dense brown fur beneath,<NL>along with a long tail and arms reaching past his knees.<NL>It was nearly indistinguishable from the monkeys of the wilderness,<NL><NL>save for his distinctly human hands and face.<NL>He exactly matched the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> had seen in those strange dreams...
edb7acc2-79c3-441d-9ba2-0009ff206bac/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一路紧跟说书人，奔至山谷内，<NL>说书人刚刚进得谷中，便好似野马脱缰，<NL>一路欢跳雀跃，信手解开衣物，胡乱抛下，<NL>不多时已现出身上浓密的棕毛，<NL>以及修长的尾巴，过膝的双臂，<NL>与山野中的灵猴相差无几，<NL><NL>可偏偏这灵猴的双手与脸依旧与寻常百姓没什么区别，<NL>倒与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>梦中所见的人面灵猴一模一样……

edb7acc2-79c3-441d-9ba2-0009ff206bac/Opt.en: (So this person... this monster is truly a transformed nimble monkey?)
edb7acc2-79c3-441d-9ba2-0009ff206bac/Opt.ru: (Итак, этот человек... этот монстр действительно превратился в проворную обезьяну?)

226c6495-fae2-49a0-ac86-641f5a53f8a0/Eve.en: The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey walked on, not aware of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s presence.<NL>He made his way to an earthen mound and rummaged through discarded clothes,<NL>carefully extracting every wild fruit received from the village children during his storytelling.<NL>He placed them reverently before the mound, then bowed deeply three times.<NL><NL>"My friends... At last, we've found the marvelous method.<NL>From this day forward, we too can join Yuanshan. Our past affinity won't have been in vain.<NL>We can become proper, upright people—respected and appreciated by the civilians..."
226c6495-fae2-49a0-ac86-641f5a53f8a0/Eve.cn: 人面灵猴浑然未觉<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>尾随而至，<NL>只径直来到一处土包前，在地上的衣物中一番摸索，<NL>将方才说书时，群童送来的野果尽数掏出，<NL>好生放在土包前，又恭敬的拜了三拜：<NL><NL>“老伙计们呐……咱终于寻得妙法，<NL>今日之后，咱们也能拜入元山，也算不枉当年的缘分，<NL>能做个威风凛凛，堂堂正正之人，受百姓感激了……”

1f0d7027-e273-4b42-9979-53ae543a3c68/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment, about to approach and ask,<NL>but unexpectedly, the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey leaped away again,<NL>disappearing into the forest in a few bounds...
1f0d7027-e273-4b42-9979-53ae543a3c68/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>沉吟片刻，正待上前一问，<NL>不想这人面灵猴再度飞身远去，<NL>几个起落，已进入山林之中……
1f0d7027-e273-4b42-9979-53ae543a3c68/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> задумался на мгновение, собираясь подойти и спросить,<NL>но неожиданно Проворная обезьяна с человеческим лицом снова отпрыгнула в сторону,<NL>исчезающий в лесу в несколько прыжков...

6f632dd0-7743-4359-8776-395706f1bcfd/Eve.en: The valley terrain was varied and seemingly repetitive.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> ventured deeper, the mist in the woods grew thicker.<NL><NL>After leaping dozens of li, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> glimpsed a sturdy figure ahead,<NL>then instantly hopped down from a branch, only to see a boar sitting cross-legged, scratching its head, thick brows furrowed.<NL>The boar had one hoof resting on a Yuanshan scripture, muttering to itself:<NL>"Honor the Buddha... Revere the Tao... Slay demons... Banish evil...<NL>Huh? Does that include us?"
6f632dd0-7743-4359-8776-395706f1bcfd/Eve.cn: 山谷中地势多变，各处都看似没有区别，<NL>随着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>愈发深入，愈感觉林中薄雾渐浓，<NL><NL>飞身跃过几十里后，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>隐隐窥得前方似乎有一道壮硕身影，<NL>当即自枝头跃下，却看见一头野猪正在盘腿挠头，粗眉紧紧皱起，<NL>这野猪一只蹄子按着元山派的典籍，口中念念有词：<NL>“……尊佛崇道……斩妖除魔……<NL>诶？那咱们算不算妖……”

b8eb5207-9c29-4100-b78d-70f8a83edc2e/Eve.en: The landing sound startled the boar, which dropped its scripture and retreated.<NL>Upon recognizing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, it let out a sigh of relief,<NL>but halfway through, the boar seemed to have second thoughts. Forcing an awkward grin, it attempted to mimic a wolf's howl:<NL>"Awoo!"
b8eb5207-9c29-4100-b78d-70f8a83edc2e/Eve.cn: 落地声响，野猪惊得浑身一颤，抛下典籍连连后退，<NL>待看清<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，才敢长出大气，<NL>然而这野猪一口气尚未出完，似乎又觉得不妥，慌忙咧嘴呲牙学起狼叫：<NL>“嗷呜！”

79870243-d64b-4d9f-8bcf-ba9742395f24/Eve.en: At the sound of its own voice, the boar's dark face flushed red.<NL>Its hooves scratched nervously from side to side, an awkwardly human gesture.<NL>Soon, it hung its head in defeat, shaking its bristling fur and muttering mournfully to itself:<NL>"The times have changed... sigh..."<NL><NL>Watching the boar's flustered attempt at composure,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> thought it might be possible to ask the creature for directions through the forest...
79870243-d64b-4d9f-8bcf-ba9742395f24/Eve.cn: 野猪见状，顿时涨的黑脸透红，<NL>两只蹄子左挠右抠，神态与人遇到窘境一般，<NL>不多时，这野猪便垂着头晃着毛，喃喃自语兀自叹息：<NL>“世道是变了嗷……唉……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>看这野猪强作镇静的慌张模样，<NL>似是可以一问林中道路……

79870243-d64b-4d9f-8bcf-ba9742395f24/Opt.en: Stay calm! Let me ask you something...
79870243-d64b-4d9f-8bcf-ba9742395f24/Opt.ru: Сохраняйте спокойствие! Позволь мне спросить тебя кое о чем...

93aa197c-01a0-4ec8-b15f-122f16a2c42d/Eve.en: The boar paid <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> absolutely no mind, crouched low, coiled its legs,<NL>and bolted into the forest in a flash,<NL>leaving no trace...
93aa197c-01a0-4ec8-b15f-122f16a2c42d/Eve.cn: 野猪全然不理<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，即刻俯身刨腿，<NL>四蹄狂奔，一溜烟似的钻入林中，<NL>不见踪影……
93aa197c-01a0-4ec8-b15f-122f16a2c42d/Eve.ru: Кабан заплатил <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> абсолютно лишенный разума, низко пригнувшийся, свернувшийся кольцом на ногах,<NL>и в мгновение ока умчался в лес,<NL>не оставляя никаких следов...

f2402c60-5e8f-4023-a584-8a9e20539388/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> leaped forward along the path.<NL>The forest grew denser, the demonic mist thicker.<NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> landed again to discern the direction,<NL>the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey was nowhere to be seen. Only the gentle breeze whispered through the forest.<NL><NL>Seeing the dense woods, deep valleys, and humid mist,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered for a moment and decided to leave...
f2402c60-5e8f-4023-a584-8a9e20539388/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一路奔跃，<NL>树木渐密，翠叶渐繁，又逢林中妖雾越发浓厚，<NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>再次落地，试图辨明方位时，<NL>却已不见人面灵猴踪影，唯有林中清风徐徐吹来，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眼看周遭林密谷深，潮气氤氲，<NL>思索片刻，决定暂离此地……

8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turned around while deep in thought,<NL>only to see a pair of bright, eerie apricot eyes.<NL>It was a nine-foot giant python, its belly as thick as a barrel, its tongue like blood.<NL>The creature met <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s gaze directly, leaving <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> frozen...
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正沉思着回过身去，<NL>陡然见得一对明晃晃的幽幽杏眸，<NL>却正是一条九尺巨蟒，腹粗如桶，蛇信如血，<NL>恰与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>四目相对，一时惊住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……

8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.en: (Take stance) What monster dares to ambush here!
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.cn: （提气架势）何方妖孽！安敢设伏！
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.ru: (Примите Стойку) Какое чудовище осмелилось устроить здесь засаду?

8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.en: (Stay alert) Spare the innocent. Don't spill blood in vain...
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.cn: （凝神戒备）莫要害人，徒造杀孽……
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.ru: (Будьте начеку) Пощадите невинных. Не проливай кровь понапрасну...

8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.en: (Back away) You... are you a monster too?
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.cn: （暗暗后撤）你……难不成也是妖怪？

8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.en: (Gather power) A python like this is rare. Let's see your power...
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.cn: （抚掌聚力）这等巨蟒，天下罕见，且让我试试你有何本事……
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.ru: (Набирайте силу) Такой питон, как этот, встречается редко. Давай посмотрим на твою силу...

8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.en: (Wield weapon) Die, monster! You'll make a fine side dish!
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.cn: （持武挥出）妖畜受死！正好给我做份下酒菜！
8e63234b-e662-4e92-83b3-e944a05a335a/Opt.ru: (Орудуй Оружием) Умри, чудовище! Из тебя получится прекрасный гарнир!

b91e98da-ea14-48ac-ac03-e9703f9bb899/Eve.en: Unfazed, the python simply raised its eyelids, shook its head,<NL>and glided forward with an air of indifference. It brought its slender tail close to its mouth and hissed,<NL>"Shh! Keep it down!<NL>Stop making such a fuss. There's a patient here..."
b91e98da-ea14-48ac-ac03-e9703f9bb899/Eve.cn: 巨蟒见状不急不恼，只是眼睑高抬，抿着嘴晃着头，<NL>旁若无人般滑动长躯，将细尾搭至口边，嘘声道：<NL>“嘘！小声点小声点！<NL>大惊小怪的，有病人呢……”
b91e98da-ea14-48ac-ac03-e9703f9bb899/Eve.ru: Невозмутимый питон просто поднял веки и покачал головой,<NL>и скользнул вперед с безразличным видом. Он поднес свой тонкий хвостик поближе ко рту и зашипел,<NL>- Тсс! Потише!<NL>Перестань поднимать такой шум. Здесь пациент..."

1624e3ea-11c7-455a-b30b-e8823e7b2aa4/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> followed the python's gaze and<NL>spotted an elderly woodcutter, nearly seventy years old, lying beneath a distant tree atop a thick bed of leaves.<NL>Both his left leg and waist were wrapped in torn cloth strips, small bloodstains seeping through the makeshift bandages.<NL>He must have taken a fall and ended up in this sorry state.<NL><NL>The woodcutter's breathing came heavy and labored; clearly, he'd been injured for quite some time.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> couldn't suppress a surge of doubt...
1624e3ea-11c7-455a-b30b-e8823e7b2aa4/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>随着巨蟒的目光望去，<NL>只见远处树下，正有一年近七旬的樵夫躺在厚厚的叶堆上，<NL>其左腿与腰腹皆缠着破布，布间渗出点点血渍，<NL>应当是不慎跌落，方才摔成这般模样，<NL><NL>樵夫现下呼吸粗重，显然其已伤了有些时辰，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>不禁疑虑丛生……

411af379-bacf-4979-aee5-7683a7075cc9/Eve.en: Seeing this, the python narrowed its eyes, raised its massive mouth, and seemed to give a wry smile.<NL>After confirming <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> would make no further aggressive moves, it brought its slender tail close to its mouth and hissed,<NL>"Shh! Don't be so jumpy!<NL>Keep your voice down. There's a patient here..."
411af379-bacf-4979-aee5-7683a7075cc9/Eve.cn: 巨蟒见状双目眯缝，巨口扬起，神色似乎是在苦笑，<NL>确认<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>没有进一步动作，这才将细尾搭至口边，嘘声道：<NL>“嘘！别一惊一乍的，<NL>小声些，有病人呢……”

5993ab32-ebce-4ffe-9e7a-93b356aa6cd1/Eve.en: The python's eyes widened in astonishment, its mouth gaping, as though utterly surprised.<NL>After a long pause, it brought its slender tail to its mouth and hissed,<NL>"Shh! What else would I be?<NL>Take it easy. There's a patient here..."
5993ab32-ebce-4ffe-9e7a-93b356aa6cd1/Eve.cn: 巨蟒闻言盆口大张，双目因错愕而大睁，<NL>似是惊讶不已，半晌方才将细尾搭至口边，嘘声道：<NL>“嘘！不然我是什么？<NL>轻点儿轻点儿，有病人呢……”
5993ab32-ebce-4ffe-9e7a-93b356aa6cd1/Eve.ru: Глаза питона расширились от изумления, его пасть была разинута, как будто он был крайне удивлен.<NL>После долгой паузы он поднес свой тонкий хвост ко рту и зашипел,<NL>- Тсс! Кем еще я мог бы быть?<NL>Успокойся. Здесь пациент..."

822d45d7-9f31-45d8-9a37-1b7965456971/Eve.en: Seeing this, the python flicked its tail across its forehead, let out a long sigh, and slowly retreated.<NL>After a long wait with no movement from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, it brought its slender tail to its mouth and hissed,<NL>"Shh! Alright, alright...<NL>Keep your voice down. There's a patient here..."
822d45d7-9f31-45d8-9a37-1b7965456971/Eve.cn: 巨蟒见状摆尾抚额，长叹一声，缓缓向后退去，<NL>良久不见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>动作，这才将细尾搭至口边，嘘声道：<NL>“嘘！行了行了，<NL>小声些，有病人呢……”

bd06c4ea-eba9-4126-9d3b-285aadd9ca5c/Eve.en: Seeing this, the python recoiled and darted to the side.<NL>Its massive mouth twitched, its tongue flicked wildly, and it hurriedly brought its slender tail to its mouth, hissing,<NL>"Shh! Keep it down!<NL>What's going on? There's a patient here..."
bd06c4ea-eba9-4126-9d3b-285aadd9ca5c/Eve.cn: 巨蟒见状缩身避过，急急窜至一旁，<NL>巨口抽搐着，信子狂甩，赶忙将细尾搭至口边，嘘声道：<NL>“嘘！小声点小声点！<NL>这是做甚？有病人呢……”
bd06c4ea-eba9-4126-9d3b-285aadd9ca5c/Eve.ru: Увидев это, питон отпрянул и метнулся в сторону.<NL>Его массивная пасть дернулась, язык дико щелкнул, и он поспешно поднес свой тонкий хвост ко рту, шипя,<NL>- Тсс! Потише!<NL>Что происходит? Здесь пациент..."

a9267770-6289-4c47-95c7-6cd1b87776f1/Eve.en: The giant python drooped its massive mouth and cast its eyes sideways, much like a human rolling their eyes.<NL>"What is it? Since you're here,<NL>you can apply the medicine to this young man; having hands will be more convenient..."<NL>With that, the python slithered and shook its body, dropping the herbs from its back in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Seeing the herbs of uneven quality and the woodcutter's prolonged injury,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> couldn't help but sigh softly...
a9267770-6289-4c47-95c7-6cd1b87776f1/Eve.cn: 巨蟒巨口下撇，双目横斜，极像人所翻白眼之状：<NL>“干嘛干嘛？正好有你在此，<NL>便由你来替这少年上药，有手到底方便不少……”<NL>说罢巨蟒滑动抖身，将背上的草药卸在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见得一地草药良莠不齐，又看樵夫已受伤多时，<NL>不由微微一叹……

a9267770-6289-4c47-95c7-6cd1b87776f1/Opt.en: (Take out needles to apply medicine) I have my own way to treat this...
a9267770-6289-4c47-95c7-6cd1b87776f1/Opt.ru: (Достаньте иглы, чтобы нанести лекарство) У меня есть свой собственный способ относиться к этому...

d468e23b-bacb-4df3-a41b-0fbf89fb8a6e/Eve.en: Seeing this, the python's eyes glowed intensely, its red tongue flicking lightly.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> began to treat the woodcutter's wounds, the python leaned in to observe closely.<NL>"Like this... and like that..."<NL>"Wonderful! What's the principle behind manipulating these silver needles?"<NL>"So that's how it works... applying the ointment here has this kind of effect..."<NL>The python was extremely curious and kept asking questions, causing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s ears to ring...
d468e23b-bacb-4df3-a41b-0fbf89fb8a6e/Eve.cn: 巨蟒见状双目灼灼，红信轻晃，<NL>待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>开始为樵夫疗伤，巨蟒当即凑来细细观摩：<NL>“如此……这般……”<NL>“妙极妙极！这银针运气是何讲究？”<NL>“原来如此……将药膏敷至此处还有这般效用……”<NL>巨蟒好奇心切，不住打听，令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>耳边聒噪不止……

095574f9-52fc-4454-a150-a4c3d551d936/Eve.en: The python reluctantly lowered its head, muttering no further words,<NL>though it occasionally stretched its neck to shake its head and peer around.<NL><NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> had finished tending to the woodcutter, the python couldn't help but praise,<NL>"You truly are a divine physician!<NL>Your miraculous skill is truly eye-opening..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> didn't wish to dwell on medical arts, yet remained deeply puzzled by the python's actions...
095574f9-52fc-4454-a150-a4c3d551d936/Eve.cn: 巨蟒这才悻悻垂首，嘟囔着一言不发，<NL>只偶尔伸着脖子摇头晃脑，东瞧西看，<NL><NL>等<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>为樵夫调理妥当，巨蟒不由连连称赞：<NL>“大侠果乃神医也！<NL>这般妙手回春的本事，当真教人大开眼界……”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>不欲在医术一道上纠缠，却对巨蟒所做所为甚是不解……

095574f9-52fc-4454-a150-a4c3d551d936/Opt.en: Since you can speak, you're clearly no ordinary monster. So why would you save a human?
095574f9-52fc-4454-a150-a4c3d551d936/Opt.cn: 你既能口吐人言，自然算不得小妖，为何要救人性命？
095574f9-52fc-4454-a150-a4c3d551d936/Opt.ru: Поскольку ты можешь говорить, ты явно не обычный монстр. Так зачем же тебе спасать человека?

d975542e-0297-44b5-8a7a-d980bbe719cc/Eve.en: Hearing this, the python raised its nose and head, its red tongue flicking upward, and spoke,<NL>"I was born in the territory of Greater and Lesser Yuanshan, and have followed the Yuanshan sect ever since.<NL>I've seen countless Yuanshan disciples aiding those in need everywhere.<NL>How could I refuse to save a life with such a small effort?"<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalled what the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey had said at the valley entrance,<NL>and this confusion deepened...
d975542e-0297-44b5-8a7a-d980bbe719cc/Eve.cn: 巨蟒闻言抬鼻昂首，红信高翘，得意地开口道：<NL>“我乃大小元山地界所生，自拜元山门楣，<NL>曾见多少元山弟子周济四方，<NL>区区举手之劳，怎会见死不救？”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>复想起山谷口人面灵猴所言，<NL>心中不解更深几分……

d975542e-0297-44b5-8a7a-d980bbe719cc/Opt.en: Was that nimble monkey the same way?

de5fba91-83e3-42d3-8097-1bf41f96cfeb/Eve.en: The python had already slid next to the woodcutter, nudging him gently to carry him on its back, and replied casually,<NL>"Exactly. The monkey seems to have learned some secret arts recently, always saying it wants to lead everyone to transform and make a pilgrimage.<NL>Oh, you didn't keep up with him—just head that way.<NL>I'll take this young man back to the village first..."<NL>Before the words had even finished, the python was already carrying the white-haired woodcutter into the woods...
de5fba91-83e3-42d3-8097-1bf41f96cfeb/Eve.cn: 巨蟒却早已滑至樵夫身旁，侧身轻顶将樵夫驮起，信口回应道：<NL>“正是，这猴子近来像是得了什么秘法，总说要带大伙化形拜山，<NL>对了，你刚刚没跟上他，往那边走便是，<NL>我且先送这少年回村了……”<NL>话音未落，巨蟒早已驮着须发全白的樵夫遁入林中……

0a431f86-18ef-4aa0-b86e-6bba2ee3b7c0/Eve.en: After traveling another dozen li, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pushed aside dense leaves and suddenly stepped into an open clearing.<NL>Scattered paper leaves everywhere, green, yellow, white, and brown, all mixed together.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gazed and saw they were covered in all sorts of crooked scribbles.<NL>Only three spots, only three characters, were clearly discernible at a glance:<NL>Heaven, Earth, Human...
0a431f86-18ef-4aa0-b86e-6bba2ee3b7c0/Eve.cn: 复行十数里，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>拨开密叶，豁然踏进一片开阔空地，<NL>却见纸张叶片遍地散落，青黄白褐，各种颜色相交，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>定睛细看，其上布满歪七扭八的种种笔迹涂划，<NL>唯有三处点位，唯有三字，一眼可辨：<NL>天、地、人……

c74d49db-a55d-484e-8543-f7e4b65401d6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> inhaled and advanced slowly with light steps.<NL>After only a few paces, wisps of faint smoke rose from a bronze incense burner.<NL>Looking back down, paw prints beneath the papers can be seen, and various hoof prints scattered among the leaf gaps.<NL>Moreover, several sword pommels and hilts were buried deep in the soil, all pointing toward the incense burner,<NL>as if a solemn oath had been sworn here not long ago...
c74d49db-a55d-484e-8543-f7e4b65401d6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>提气轻步缓缓前进，<NL>不过几步便看见几缕袅袅烟火，正从一方青铜香炉中腾起，<NL>再回身低头看去，只见纸张下掩盖着遍地爪印，叶缝间四散着各处蹄痕，<NL>更有数把深深埋于土中的刀环剑柄，一齐指向香炉，<NL>像是不久前，此地刚刚进行过一场誓师……

825a4240-604d-4355-95d7-e1b479d552e3/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> broke through layers of demonic mist and discerned the forest barriers,<NL>finally emerging from between the branches and green leaves.<NL>Seeing the vibrant greenery on the mountainside and feeling the cool breeze under the clear sky,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s gaze sharpened and recognized something beneath the heavy covering of grass and leaves at the mountain's foot;<NL>there was a wide cave entrance concealed.<NL><NL>Yet, next to the cave stood a towering figure,<NL>covered in mottled patterns and countless scars. Its posture revealed prominent bones, standing straight with a powerful frame.<NL>Long whiskers swayed gently in the wind, and eyes closed as though asleep.<NL>It was a giant tiger, square-browed and cloaked in snow-white fur. Its upturned eyes were blind, yet still commanded awe.<NL>It sat cross-legged, embracing a withered tree...
825a4240-604d-4355-95d7-e1b479d552e3/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>闯过层层妖雾，又辨清重重林障，<NL>终于自青幽枝叶间觅出，<NL>眼看山麓侧翠意勃发，身感晴空下凉风回荡，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>目光如炬，当即认得在山脚下一处重重草叶掩埋后，<NL>正有一人宽洞窟隐蔽于此，<NL><NL>可偏偏洞旁高耸一道彪形壮影，<NL>那身影花斑缭乱横插千道伤疤，其姿态筋骨峥嵘直挺一身雄骨，<NL>长须缕缕随风飘动，双眼定定微阖似眠，<NL>竟是头方额白绒胜雪，吊睛虽闭自威的巨虎，<NL>正怀抱枯树，盘腿打坐……

051ac5a9-f858-45ab-9cf4-0789e5a786c8/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> took only a few steps, the blind tiger pricked up its ears.<NL>Then it suddenly swung the trunk, blocking the cave with a sharp gust.<NL>It slowly opened its mouth, and its rumbling roar shook the surrounding trees:<NL><NL>"A great array is about to commence here. I stand guard here. Keep your distance.<NL>Young one, turn back now. If you've lost your way, you may sit with this old one for a time.<NL>Once the formation is complete, I shall escort you from the forest..."<NL><NL>Thinking back on the journey, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> could not help but worry that the Trinity Demonsbane Array was already complete,<NL>and countless lives may be lost for nothing...
051ac5a9-f858-45ab-9cf4-0789e5a786c8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只踏出几步，老虎已经动耳细听，<NL>旋即猛地一挥树干，带起凌冽劲风横栏洞口，<NL>随后悠悠张口，隆隆虎声震动周遭林木：<NL><NL>“此地正有大阵将起，老夫护法于此，生人勿近，<NL>小友快快请回，若是误入迷途，且陪老夫坐些时辰，<NL>待阵法得成，自送小友出林……”<NL><NL>想起一路种种所见，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>不禁忧心绝魔大阵已成，令人白白送了性命……

051ac5a9-f858-45ab-9cf4-0789e5a786c8/Opt.en: Was the Demonsbane Array really led by the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey?

eb4c8f54-076b-4eca-8ffe-5885f684c88b/Eve.en: Hearing this, the blind tiger lit up with delight, his sightless eyes widening.<NL>One powerful arm retracted his claws and reached out—gentle yet swift as lightning.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> felt a massive, furry paw patting the forehead.<NL>Then came a booming laugh:<NL><NL>"Ah! A physique of steel, great Root Bone, and steady Qi!<NL>I made a grave error in judgment. You are truly an exceptional hero.<NL>Since you've come for that monkey lad, you must be his close friend, right?"<NL><NL>This left <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> torn between amusement and exasperation...
eb4c8f54-076b-4eca-8ffe-5885f684c88b/Eve.cn: 老虎听到这话顿时面露喜色，双目大睁，<NL>一只壮臂早已收爪探来，初时柔和无风，转瞬迅疾如电，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只觉那蓬茸大掌在自己的头顶额间轻触揉搓片刻，<NL>随后才听到嘹亮虎笑：<NL><NL>“哎呀哎呀，身强体健，根骨牢靠，气稳脉实，<NL>老夫倒是走了眼，小友可真真是个不得了的侠士，<NL>如此时刻，既来寻那灵猴小子，定是他的至交好友吧？”<NL><NL>此话一出，顿时令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>啼笑皆非……

798bebb2-deb7-40e2-aae9-3eaa908d7a29/Eve.en: But before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> could finish,<NL>the blind tiger had already picked up the withered tree, gazing blankly at the forest as it rambled on:<NL><NL>"For a monster like me, cultivation is no easy feat. Attaining sentience and divine grace alone takes a hundred years of effort.<NL>Without immense luck, one can only train day and night.<NL>To achieve peerless martial arts that rival the Blackclad bastard would take who knows how many years.<NL>How fortunate to have a friend like you to help..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> felt speechless as the tiger talked to itself...
798bebb2-deb7-40e2-aae9-3eaa908d7a29/Eve.cn: 但不等<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>说完，<NL>老虎已抱起枯树空望山林，自顾自地絮叨感慨起来：<NL><NL>“老夫这等妖类，修行不易，单是开智受神便需百年时日，<NL>若非有什么天大的运气，只得日夜苦练，<NL>欲要练出那玄甲老怪那般盖世武功，也不知需得多少年月日夜熬打筋骨，<NL>亏得有小友这般人物相助，幸甚矣……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见这盲虎只顾自说自话，几分无奈油然而生……

2d46d7aa-fa7b-4722-91b0-b33bdad05e7a/Eve.en: Unfazed by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s words, the blind tiger stroked his whiskers,<NL>turned back to the withered tree in his paw, and murmured:<NL><NL>"It's all coming together. The monkey lad discovered a way to channel the Qi of Cosmic Trinity,<NL>and it aligns perfectly with our innate Monstrous Qi.<NL>These past few days have been quite busy indeed—fetching bones from the village for a test of will, entering ancient tombs to anchor the array pivot.<NL>If we can truly complete this array and transform into handsome youths and fair maidens, that would fulfill a long-held wish..."<NL><NL>Hearing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalled traveling with A'Nian and anchoring pivots in towns and villages across the land.<NL>A wave of nostalgia surfaces, bringing to mind the similarities with what these monsters were doing.
2d46d7aa-fa7b-4722-91b0-b33bdad05e7a/Eve.cn: 老虎捋着长须，仿若不曾听到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>所言，<NL>只是用爪子蹭动着掌中枯树，仍旧自言自语道：<NL><NL>“如今好了啊，灵猴小子寻得引动三才之气法门，<NL>正与吾等精怪天生妖气相合，<NL>近几日却是好生忙活，又是去村中取骨试心，又是入坟内立住阵脚，<NL>若当真能结下这甚么大阵，个个化作俊后生俏妮子，<NL>也算了了心事一桩嘞……”<NL><NL>听到此处，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忆起昔日与阿念一同周游各处，<NL>在城镇村寨中布下阵脚的种种经过，<NL>既感怀故人，又思及如今群妖所作之事异同之处……

2d46d7aa-fa7b-4722-91b0-b33bdad05e7a/Opt.en: (A quick question) How did the nimble monkey learn about this array?
2d46d7aa-fa7b-4722-91b0-b33bdad05e7a/Opt.cn: （姑且一问）却不知灵猴如何知晓这阵法？

90c2e66b-061e-486d-a360-8600a8fa0dc3/Eve.en: The blind tiger grinned, and his vacant gaze returned:<NL>"The origin is hard to explain.<NL>I don't know what happened at the Yuanshan Sect that day—it caused an uproar that shook heaven and earth.<NL>Fortunately, the sect remained safe due to its accumulated virtue and heavenly grace.<NL>It was also destined that the monkey lad would suffer much impact near the site.<NL>He unexpectedly gained some Qi of Cosmic Trinity, transforming into a half-human form.<NL>If the array is completed, all our youngsters may receive this blessing.<NL>By then, joining the Yuanshan Sect would be a great merit..."<NL><NL>Upon entering the valley this time, every monster <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> met wished to join the Yuanshan Sect.<NL>Hearing this wish voiced again made it difficult to resist probing the matter further.
90c2e66b-061e-486d-a360-8600a8fa0dc3/Eve.cn: 老虎咧嘴一笑，双目缓缓转来：<NL>“此事来由，倒是为难老夫，<NL>不知那日元山派中出了甚事，闹腾得天崩地裂，声若震雷，<NL>得亏元山派积德行善，当是吉人自有天助，保全无碍，<NL>也合该灵猴小子有此祸福，虽在近处遭了许多冲击，<NL>反倒得了几分三才之气，化作个半人半兽之相，<NL>若阵成了，后生们都有此福，<NL>到时入得元山派山门，也是大大功德……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>此番入了山谷之中，一路所见妖怪，个个都想投入元山派，<NL>如今再次听闻，着实难忍探究之心……

90c2e66b-061e-486d-a360-8600a8fa0dc3/Opt.en: Why do all the monsters in this mountain follow Yuanshan's precepts and wish to join the sect?

fdbf4b8a-55e8-446b-9d56-da4f1bc73afb/Eve.en: The blind tiger couldn't help but laugh heartily, delighted and proud:<NL>"Haha, the youngsters and I have a connection with the Yuanshan Sect.<NL>Those Xiakes didn't just fight alongside us against that Blackclad bastard;<NL>they also healed my injuries and gave my girl a gift.<NL>At that time, the monkey lad was the most spirited of us all, drinking and feasting with the Xiakes all night.<NL><NL>When they parted, everyone agreed to gather again someday for another drunken feast.<NL>So, they passed on quite a few of their formidable techniques and profound scriptures to us.<NL>The Yuanshan cultivation path is inherently upright, which is most beneficial for us spirits to curb our wild nature.<NL>That's how we arrived at where we are today..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> Upon hearing this account, recalled the storyteller, the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey from the teahouse, and felt a wave of emotion...
fdbf4b8a-55e8-446b-9d56-da4f1bc73afb/Eve.cn: 老虎不禁爽朗大笑起来，似是开怀得意：<NL>“哈哈哈，老夫和这帮后生们，可与元山派有渊源嘞，<NL>兀些个义士不但和咱们一道斩了那玄甲老怪，<NL>还替老夫治好了伤势，送了老夫那妮子一笔贺礼，<NL>那时就数灵猴这后生最是亢奋，与义士们把酒言欢彻夜痛饮，<NL><NL>分别之际，大伙约好来日再尽兴醉过一场，<NL>于是传了咱们不少威武招式和玄奥经籍，<NL>这元山修行本就刚正中直，对咱们这些精怪收束野性最是有益，<NL>这才有了咱们今日咧……”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>闻言，又思及人面灵猴在茶摊所讲评书，一时感慨……

fdbf4b8a-55e8-446b-9d56-da4f1bc73afb/Opt.en: Though there's no formal master-disciple relationship, the meaning of inheritance exists; these monsters truly value gratitude...
fdbf4b8a-55e8-446b-9d56-da4f1bc73afb/Opt.cn: 虽无师徒之名，倒真有传承之义，群妖当真念恩重情……

That Blackclad bastard was wreaking havoc in the mountain forest back then, and no one could stop him.<NL>Not to mention that little python family..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> grew worried the blind tiger would get carried away again and quickly tried to stop him...
02513eab-d617-4969-b441-f0856c02c498/Eve.cn: 老虎摆弄着掌中枯树，抖动长须，再度絮叨起来：<NL>“太复杂的事，老夫如今也不去琢磨，<NL>老夫与兀些后生都晓得全这恩义，<NL>小友你是不知，那玄甲老怪彼时为祸山林，无人能管，<NL>且说那小蟒一家……”<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>生怕此妖再次感发不止，赶忙阻拦……

He seemed to forget the initial warning as the guardian...
0c7096bd-0dbf-418e-abc4-588883bebcb1/Eve.cn: 老虎猛地一拍白额，摇头笑道：<NL>“是了是了，全怪老夫话稠误事，<NL>小友既来寻那灵猴小子，定有要紧之事相助，<NL>快快进去，莫要误了时辰……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>还欲分说，此妖已将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>扶腰推肩，<NL>送<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>入得洞内，似是忘了最初护法之言……

53a7a86b-c58f-49bd-a2a9-692d06da45a7/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> entered the cave<NL>and saw numerous connected openings, through which sparse light filtered down.<NL>The interior had been swept clean, almost spotless,<NL>except for the walls covered in dark crimson, winding lines.<NL>These lines were continuous and fluid, stretching deep into the cave like long, racing shadows...
53a7a86b-c58f-49bd-a2a9-692d06da45a7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>走进洞窟内，<NL>只见洞间相接多处孔眼，自其中投下稀疏明光，<NL>洞内早已被打扫的干干净净，几近一尘不染，<NL>唯独洞壁上满布暗赤色的曲折线条，<NL>这些线条连贯流畅，直通洞内深处，似如奔行的长影……

97591366-a9ed-4baa-b7b2-6ad161aa8a5e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> stepped forward to examine closely<NL>and suddenly found <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> own reflection on the wall perfectly overlapped with one of the crimson lines.<NL>Taking another step forward, it merged with the shape of another line.<NL>Every step and movement seemed to follow some kind of pattern...
97591366-a9ed-4baa-b7b2-6ad161aa8a5e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>踏步近前正欲细观，<NL>忽见己身倒影与壁上线条恰好重叠于一处，<NL>再一踏步前行，又与另一处线条形态相合，<NL>一步一动，皆似依据某种阵势而动……

f0e92656-6bfd-4f59-9078-119feec7d041/Eve.en: Guided by the residual light in the cave, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> followed the lines on the wall.<NL>With each step and gesture, a subtle flow of sword clash emerged.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s movements grew swifter, and the Tiangang Qi sharpened,<NL>identical to what was seen within the past Yuanshan Demonsbane Array.<NL>Who would have thought the mountain monsters had truly managed to record the profound secrets of the array this way...
f0e92656-6bfd-4f59-9078-119feec7d041/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>迎洞中残光而行，随洞壁线条而动，<NL>一步一举间，竟隐有刀光剑气流转，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>动作愈疾，罡气愈自明锐，<NL>与昔日元山大阵中所见别无二致，<NL>不想山中群妖，当真以此法记下了元山封魔大阵的诀窍……

f0e92656-6bfd-4f59-9078-119feec7d041/Opt.en: (The secrets of the arts of monsters are truly beyond common sense...)
f0e92656-6bfd-4f59-9078-119feec7d041/Opt.cn: （妖法之奇，实在令人匪夷所思……）
f0e92656-6bfd-4f59-9078-119feec7d041/Opt.ru: (Тайны искусства монстров действительно выходят за рамки здравого смысла...)

83a102cf-7144-4650-9777-9b3eae237d58/Eve.en: The cave is dry and warm; a gentle hot breeze blows from a distant, bright hole.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> holds their breath, steps silently, crouches low, and sneaks to the edge of the cave entrance, peeking inside.<NL><NL>Inside, a group of people are covered in fur, bearing horns, pointed snouts, and fangs.<NL>They are actually a gathering of spirits and monsters of all sizes!<NL>Each is hauling various armor and tactical formations, creating a bustling scene of intense activity.<NL>But the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey is nowhere to be seen...
83a102cf-7144-4650-9777-9b3eae237d58/Eve.cn: 窟中干燥温暖，微微热风缓缓自远处一道光亮孔洞处吹来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>屏息静步，伏低身子，潜行至洞口边缘，偷偷望去，<NL><NL>只见洞内一干人等，各个披毛生角、尖嘴獠牙，<NL>竟是一众大小精怪齐聚一堂，<NL>各自搬动诸般兵甲阵图，正是一片热火朝天的景象，<NL>却唯独不见人面灵猴踪影……

61c088a5-b699-499f-b3b2-ee545926125c/Eve.en: The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey was positioned at the array's very crux, gesticulating wildly as it commanded the horde of beasts.<NL>His imposing demeanor was completely different from when he was telling stories at the teahouse.<NL>He already possessed something of the bearing of a true Yuanshan disciple.<NL>"Like this... and this way..."<NL>"Leopard Three! Place that blade here!"<NL>"After we activate the array, everyone just focus on channeling your Monstrous Qi toward the crux..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> closely observed the arrangement inside the cave,<NL>calculating the array's completion time and looking for a way to break it...
61c088a5-b699-499f-b3b2-ee545926125c/Eve.cn: 只见那人面灵猴正居于阵眼，手舞足蹈着对群妖发号施令，<NL>其气势姿态，与茶摊中说书之时判若两人，<NL>俨然已有几分元山弟子之风：<NL>“如此……这般……”<NL>“豹三！那刀往此处放！”<NL>“一会儿启阵后，各位只管将妖气推运至面前阵眼……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>细看洞内布阵之景，<NL>掐算着成阵所需时间，寻觅该从何处破阵……

dfb6ba46-af21-4c3b-921a-38f05d39a8fd/Eve.en: The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey raised its arm and shouted, its joy overflowing.<NL>"Everyone, it is almost complete!<NL>The Monstrous Qi we have accumulated through years of tireless practice is for this very moment.<NL>Now, we only need to sacrifice a portion of it to activate the Qi of Cosmic Trinity<NL>and merge the primordial energy of Heaven and Earth with our beastly bodies to transform!<NL><NL>For the debt of past teachings, and the righteousness of fighting side by side,<NL>we can repay all this favor once we join the Yuanshan Sect,<NL>and our cultivation will advance without wasting another hundred years!"<NL>As soon as the words fell, the monsters in the cave cheered loudly,<NL>but their manner was totally different from the solemn stance of those Yuanshan disciples in the past...
dfb6ba46-af21-4c3b-921a-38f05d39a8fd/Eve.cn: 人面灵猴振臂一呼，狂喜之情溢于言表：<NL>“诸位，将要成矣，<NL>吾等积年累月苦修不辍，所聚妖气，正为此时，<NL>如今只需舍去一部分，便可引动三才之气，<NL>以天地鸿蒙，为妖身浑然，助吾等化形！<NL><NL>昔日传道授业之恩，往日并肩除妖之义，<NL>待咱们一同投入元山麾下，自可全此漫漫恩义，<NL>功力精进何须再待百年空过！”<NL>话音刚落，洞中群妖亦是欢呼高喝，<NL>却与昔日元山派肃穆立阵之势迥乎不同……

6e5746e0-97b3-467a-b2a0-4154e99859bb/Eve.en: The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey was speaking with great excitement.<NL>A spotted leopard slowly walked into the array's crux and spoke with concern:<NL>"Monkey Five, is this absolutely safe?<NL>The Yuanshan Demonsbane Array activation that day was earth-shattering. I wonder what the Qi of Cosmic Trinity was used for...<NL><NL>Jinzhong has many dark tales; countless rulers are buried here.<NL>You have seen ghostly soldiers marching at night and stone beasts attacking people.<NL>Moreover, that Blackscale Serpent is not buried far away. We must not cause any disaster..."<NL><NL>This reminded <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> of the tragedy when the Three Demons gained power and wreaked havoc upon Yuanshan after the Yuanshan Sect completed its array...
6e5746e0-97b3-467a-b2a0-4154e99859bb/Eve.cn: 人面灵猴正说至激动处，<NL>一花斑豹妖缓缓走入得阵眼，带着担忧开口：<NL>“猴五，当真万全无虞？<NL>那日元山启阵可端得是石破天惊，也不知所引三才之气用于何处……<NL><NL>晋中旧事本就颇多，王侯将相埋骨不知几许，<NL>你也曾见鬼兵夜行，石兽袭人，<NL>况且玄甲那黑鳞蛇妖也埋得不远，千万别闹起甚么灾殃……”<NL><NL>此言一出，却令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忆起元山派成阵后，<NL>三魔得气现形，为祸元山的惨状……

a11d8a42-38f7-48aa-a13b-6c96ffc5846d/Eve.en: The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey immediately grew anxious, scratching his ears and cheeks.<NL>He roared, pouncing on the leopard, pinning it down firmly.<NL>"You heartless fiend! Who taught us that knowledge?<NL>Clear inside, tough outside; never flee from enemies, never rush to kill!<NL>Vanquish evil, uphold justice, aid those in peril, cultivate through hardship, and adhere to precepts!<NL><NL>Didn't we take human form precisely to fulfill this master-disciple bond, guard this region,<NL>and work with Yuanshan disciples to eradicate evil?<NL>Are you truly willing to waste your life mimicking others?"
a11d8a42-38f7-48aa-a13b-6c96ffc5846d/Eve.cn: 人面灵猴立时急得抓耳挠腮，<NL>哇呀呀吼叫着扑倒豹妖，将豹妖牢牢按住：<NL>“好你个没心肝的妖怪！是谁教得咱们，<NL>内也清明，外也坚韧，遇敌不避，杀敌不急之言！<NL>除魔卫道，扶危济困，清净苦修，凝心持正之戒！<NL><NL>咱们化形，不就是为了全此师徒恩义，守卫一方，<NL>与元山的师兄弟们一道除恶济世吗？<NL>难不成你甘愿蹉跎一辈子拾人牙慧，兀自虚度？”

a11d8a42-38f7-48aa-a13b-6c96ffc5846d/Opt.en: (Do these monsters truly consider themselves Yuanshan disciples?)
a11d8a42-38f7-48aa-a13b-6c96ffc5846d/Opt.cn: （此地群妖，当真以元山弟子自居？）
a11d8a42-38f7-48aa-a13b-6c96ffc5846d/Opt.ru: (Действительно ли эти монстры считают себя учениками Юаньшаня?)

51be0b85-dc0c-465a-93c9-f77defe6f170/Eve.en: Hearing this, the monsters fell silent, and the leopard sheepishly apologized with a nod.<NL>They then each took their positions within the array. As they were about to complete the array,<NL>it looked exactly as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> had seen at the Yuanshan Sect.<NL><NL>Having heard the argument and recalling the previous tragedy of the array's activation,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> immediately rushed toward the target spot to break the array...
51be0b85-dc0c-465a-93c9-f77defe6f170/Eve.cn: 群妖闻言皆不再言语，豹妖也讪讪地点头道歉，<NL>旋即各自入得阵中，正待完成此阵，<NL>已然与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>于元山派所见别无二致，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听得方才妖间争论，又忆起曾经启阵惨状，<NL>直向已确定破阵之处奔出……

51be0b85-dc0c-465a-93c9-f77defe6f170/Opt.en: Stop! If there is a hidden threat here, activating the Qi of Cosmic Trinity will only bring disaster!
51be0b85-dc0c-465a-93c9-f77defe6f170/Opt.cn: 不可！此地若有隐患，强引三才之气，必招灾祸！
51be0b85-dc0c-465a-93c9-f77defe6f170/Opt.ru: Остановись! Если здесь есть скрытая угроза, активация Ци Космической Троицы принесет только катастрофу!

3ee1ebaf-d281-41da-89fc-90582de2dc92/Eve.en: Upon hearing this, the monsters were startled, their movements faltering, and returned around.<NL>The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey was the first to snap back to reality, immediately charging and roaring furiously.<NL>"What nonsense!<NL>Stop that fool! We must not halt!"<NL>Shaking off their doubt, the monsters rushed quickly to their respective positions.<NL>Several bulky beasts blocked <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s path.<NL>Although they held no intent to kill, only aiming to trap <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>This was enough to keep <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> occupied and unable to break free for the time being...
3ee1ebaf-d281-41da-89fc-90582de2dc92/Eve.cn: 群妖闻言皆是一怔，动作俱为之一滞，纷纷回头瞪来，<NL>人面灵猴率先回过神来，立时狂奔怒号：<NL>“一派胡言！一派胡言！<NL>拦住他！咱们不能停！”<NL><NL>群妖这才如梦方醒，纷纷急奔各自方位，<NL>数只壮硕大妖随同人面灵猴齐齐拦住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>去路，<NL>虽无害命之意，只图困住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL>亦令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一时也分身乏术，脱身不得……

2974ae30-564d-43ed-83b3-63203afda130/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was busy fending off the siege by the monsters when a tiger's roar suddenly sounded from outside the cave:<NL>"Hey! What's with the fighting? No way!"<NL>This was immediately followed by the anxious hissing of a python:<NL>"Old Tiger! I heard it crystal clear. That one is trying to stop the monkey!"<NL><NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> resisted the monsters, hearing these words brought a sense of familiarity...
2974ae30-564d-43ed-83b3-63203afda130/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正兀自抵挡群妖围困，忽听洞外一声虎啸：<NL>“喂喂！怎的打起来！”<NL>旋即又伴随着蟒蛇急切嘶嘶声：<NL>“虎老丈！我可是听得真真切切，那人想阻拦猴子呢！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正与众妖相抗，听得此言，隐隐觉得有几分耳熟……

2974ae30-564d-43ed-83b3-63203afda130/Opt.en: (Could it be the tiger and the python...)

680b09f1-8da8-4400-8d2f-3448fac56e62/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> glances aside, only to see massive claws descending toward him.<NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> blocks them, several long tails lash at him.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees more monsters flood into the cave, packing it to capacity.<NL>Even if <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> fights on all fronts, he couldn't instantly break through the heavy blockade.<NL>The array is now complete, with the spiritual energy and Tiangang Qi faintly gathering from all directions...
680b09f1-8da8-4400-8d2f-3448fac56e62/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>分心一瞥，便有数只大爪正面压来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>方才奋力挡开，又有数条长尾直奔手脚鞭来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眼见更多山林中的妖怪涌入洞窟之中，将洞中挤得水泄不通，<NL>纵使<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>横战八方，也一时穿不过重重阻拦，<NL>此刻阵势已成，隐隐正有罡气灵息自四面八方汇聚而来……

f0c5556d-a878-4e1e-9736-ce100161514a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was locked in combat with several giant monsters,<NL>both sides holding back from fatal blows—the battle hung in careful balance.<NL><NL>As the array was activated, dense waves of sword energy erupted skyward, twisting upward like an ancient loong climbing a celestial pillar,<NL>then pouring down like the starry river in all directions.<NL>Over a hundred spikes wove together, crystallizing into something that shimmered like glaze.<NL>The spiritual Qi became immense, imbued with righteous power,<NL>forcibly pulling in the Qi of Cosmic Trinity from every corner.<NL><NL>Sensing the array was complete, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> leaped back dozens of steps,<NL>eyes fixed on both the giant monsters in front and the array itself, watching for any sign of change...
f0c5556d-a878-4e1e-9736-ce100161514a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正与数名大妖彼此缠斗，<NL>双方都不愿施以毒手，一时胜负难辨，<NL><NL>随着阵势运起，浑厚刀剑罡气凌空而起，其势初如虬龙盘柱，扶摇直上，<NL>倏忽又似天河倒泻，直坠四方，<NL>百十锋芒相合相织，隐隐化作玲珑琉璃状，<NL>霎时灵气逼人，正气浩然，<NL>天地人三才之气，已经自四面八方强引而来，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心知阵法已成，当下纵身退开数十步，<NL>与面前大妖对峙着，紧盯阵中，以防生变……

f0c5556d-a878-4e1e-9736-ce100161514a/Opt.en: (Success or failure now rests entirely upon their own fate...)
f0c5556d-a878-4e1e-9736-ce100161514a/Opt.cn: （成败祸福，就看他们自身功业造化了……）
f0c5556d-a878-4e1e-9736-ce100161514a/Opt.ru: (Успех или неудача теперь полностью зависят от их собственной судьбы...)

98266d16-b591-4c99-a85c-00d85e7278dd/Eve.en: The Qi of Cosmic Trinity settled among the monsters,<NL>entirely absorbed into their internal vital points to nourish and refine them.<NL>All the monsters sat cross-legged, concentrating their minds to cultivate.<NL>Gradually, their fur, claws, scales, and horns receded, while limbs and facial features slowly emerged.<NL>This rare phenomenon of beast transformation<NL>was slowly unfolding before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
98266d16-b591-4c99-a85c-00d85e7278dd/Eve.cn: 三才之气落于群妖之间，<NL>尽数为化入其五内关窍，滋养蕴化，<NL>群妖无不盘坐，凝神运功，<NL>渐渐褪去毛爪鳞角，慢慢生出四肢五官，<NL>这般尤为罕见的精怪化形之状，<NL>正徐徐展现于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眼前……

d76b2d51-029d-4952-bc35-d5c884367172/Eve.en: The spiritual Qi was just reaching a critical point when a sudden change occurred, shaking the earth and mountains, catching <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> off guard.<NL>The monsters were busy circulating their Qi within to protect their minds and refine the Qi of Cosmic Trinity.<NL>Occupied to control the various chaotic and turbulent energies within, they were unable to move.<NL><NL>In a moment, gloomy Monstrous Qi seeped out from underground.<NL>A gigantic black shadow burst through the cave with a roaring hiss:<NL>"Traitors and hooligans! You ally with humans and try to take my life!<NL>Pay with your life!"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> dodged amidst the falling rubble and looked up to see that the black shadow was already shattered and ruined, only a severed snake head remaining.<NL>Its black scales were dim, its long fangs broken, and the Qi surrounding its body faltered...
d76b2d51-029d-4952-bc35-d5c884367172/Eve.cn: 灵气正运转至关键处，陡变突起，地动山摇，直令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>措手不及，<NL>群妖正运转体内妖气护住心神，蕴化三才之气，<NL>控住体内诸般杂驳逆乱之气已是无暇他顾，亦是动弹不得，<NL><NL>须臾间，阴沉晦暗的妖气自地下溢散而出，<NL>一道巨大的黑影冲破洞岩，愤然嘶声轰然炸响：<NL>“逆贼！宵小！与人结伴，害孤性命！<NL>纳命来！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>在乱石崩落中闪身躲避，纵目看去，<NL>只见那黑影已是残破不堪，仅留一截蛇首，<NL>黑鳞黯淡，长牙断折，周身妖气明灭不定……

ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Eve.en: Lord... Lord Blackclad!<NL>An unknown beast cried out in alarm. The horde of monsters, already struggling to move, now trembled and froze stiff.<NL>The dense black Qi swirled wildly, sweeping several monsters into the snake's maw.<NL>Cries of agony rose and fell, crimson liquid splattering everywhere.<NL><NL>The snake's head twisted around, condensing its monstrous aura into a sudden burst.<NL>It transformed along with the head into a human form clad in black armor and a dark cloak.<NL>It stomped heavily on the ground, grinding its teeth:<NL>"Excellent! You're all here, saving me the trouble of hunting you down one by one!<NL>Today, this Lord will slaughter you all, grind you into meat paste, and devour you whole!"<NL>The horde of monsters was immobilized by the immense spiritual Qi within the array, and Lord Blackclad advanced step by step...
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Eve.cn: “玄……玄甲大王！”<NL>不知哪名精怪一声惊呼，群妖本已寸步难行，此刻更是战栗僵直，<NL>黑郁妖气兀自横飞，卷起数名妖怪投入蛇口，<NL>哀鸣声此起彼伏，赤红色四溅飞迸，<NL><NL>蛇首却是回身一拧，凝沉妖气骤然一聚，<NL>随着蛇首一同化作一名黑盔暗甲，墨袍玄披之人形，<NL>它重重踏地，咬牙切齿道：<NL>“好好好！都在此地，省得挨个去抓！<NL>今日本王便将你们全数杀光，碾做肉泥吞吃入腹！” <NL>眼看群妖被大阵中磅礴灵气限住行动，玄甲大王正步步逼近……

ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.en: (Leap forward to resist) You fiend! How dare you harm them!
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.cn: （飞身相抗）你这邪魔，安敢伤人！
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.ru: (Прыжок вперед, чтобы сопротивляться) Ты дьявол! Как ты смеешь причинять им вред!

ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.en: (Step forward to guard) You oppressed these monsters, so you'll pay the price now...
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.cn: （挺身护卫）你欺凌群妖，就该受到惩戒……
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.ru: (Шаг вперед для охраны) Вы угнетали этих монстров, так что теперь вы заплатите за это...

ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.en: (Gather Qi to stay alert) Life and death are matters of fate, but not today...
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.cn: （聚气戒备）死生有数，绝非今日……
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.ru: (Соберите Ци, чтобы оставаться начеку) Жизнь и смерть - это вопросы судьбы, но не сегодня...

ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.en: (Fiddle with sleeves) An eye for an eye may be just, but it's totally dull...
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.cn: （摆弄衣衫）以牙还牙，虽是天经地义，倒也无趣至极……
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.ru: (Возится с рукавами) Око за око, может быть, и справедливо, но это совершенно скучно...

ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.en: (Take up arms to yell) You call yourself a lord?
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.cn: （持武叫阵）就你也配自称‘大王’？
ec5d9c2b-d55d-4239-bbd8-7cf4be6c7318/Opt.ru: (Беритесь за оружие, чтобы закричать) Ты называешь себя лордом?

1f364c29-a15f-467c-853c-ca9def95dd91/Eve.en: Lord Blackclad did not evade at all, taking a direct blow from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>But as he clearly saw the distinct dent on his black armor,<NL>confusion gradually appeared on his grim face, which turned into rage as he struck swiftly.<NL>"Bastard, how dare you!"
1f364c29-a15f-467c-853c-ca9def95dd91/Eve.cn: 玄甲大王丝毫不避，正对着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>硬抗一击，<NL>但待它看清暗甲上的鲜明凹陷后，<NL>其昏黑的面庞上渐渐浮起困惑，转而骤然化为狂怒，疾疾袭来：<NL>“竖子尔敢！”
1f364c29-a15f-467c-853c-ca9def95dd91/Eve.ru: Лорд Блэкклед вообще не уклонился, приняв прямой удар от <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Но когда он ясно увидел отчетливую вмятину на своей черной Броне,<NL>на его мрачном лице постепенно появилось замешательство, которое сменилось яростью, когда он быстро нанес удар.<NL>- Ублюдок, как ты смеешь!

1f364c29-a15f-467c-853c-ca9def95dd91/Opt.en: (Charge) Let me remind you—evil can never overcome the just!
1f364c29-a15f-467c-853c-ca9def95dd91/Opt.cn: （冲撞）偏教你知道，何为邪不压正！
1f364c29-a15f-467c-853c-ca9def95dd91/Opt.ru: (Плата) Позвольте мне напомнить вам — зло никогда не сможет победить справедливость!

042d6ae3-0bc6-4f68-bf99-d3e3623e2ba3/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> clashed with Lord Blackclad.<NL>Silver weapons met dark armor in explosions of golden sparks.<NL>Fists collided with claws, each impact thundering through the cave.<NL>Monstrous Qi churned and twisted, shattering stone like a raging tempest,<NL>while True Qi stood resolute and unmovable, an unyielding mountain against the onslaught.<NL><NL>Dust and debris choked the air, the victor still unclear.<NL>The monsters trapped in the array could only watch in stunned, breathless silence.
042d6ae3-0bc6-4f68-bf99-d3e3623e2ba3/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玄甲大王战至一处，<NL>玄银相错，溅起金光流火衡飞，<NL>拳爪相击，撞起罡鸣震声呼啸，<NL>妖气汹涌漫卷，崩岩碎石如同狂风摧折，<NL>真气坚韧耸立，御敌镇威如同崇山稳牢，<NL><NL>洞中一时尘沙横飞，胜负亦是难分，<NL>阵中群妖虽然尚不能行动，却早已看得瞠目结舌……

bf70dbf1-0b15-4cba-8a72-bf3b6f89a0b8/Eve.en: Lord Blackclad's maniacal laughter echoed as immense Monstrous Qi swirled,<NL>writhing across his form like a hundred snakes.<NL>In an instant, he surged forward, wrapped in a ferocious gale.<NL>"Hypocrite! Your life ends now!"
bf70dbf1-0b15-4cba-8a72-bf3b6f89a0b8/Eve.cn: 玄甲大王恣意狂笑，任由磅礴妖气汹汹腾转，<NL>仿若百余条蛇形蛇盘桓在它身上肆意蠕动，<NL>转瞬之间，玄甲大王便缠裹着遒劲狂风攻至：<NL>“道貌岸然！纳命来！”
bf70dbf1-0b15-4cba-8a72-bf3b6f89a0b8/Eve.ru: Маниакальный смех лорда Блэкклэда эхом отдавался, когда огромная чудовищная Ци закружилась,<NL>извиваясь по его телу, как сотня змей.<NL>В одно мгновение он рванулся вперед, охваченный свирепым штормом.<NL>- Лицемер! Твоя жизнь сейчас закончится!"

9e5adf57-fd50-4ea9-b25f-fb3e9c722af2/Eve.en: Lord Blackclad's expression darkened.<NL>Fierce Monstrous Qi erupted from him, coiling through the cave like a raging flood loong.<NL>At the same moment, this snake charged forward with his withered black arms.<NL>"What kind of savage are you to speak to me of karma!"
9e5adf57-fd50-4ea9-b25f-fb3e9c722af2/Eve.cn: 玄甲大王面色转阴，<NL>凶戾妖气喷薄而出，狂舞如蛟，在洞中各处纠缠萦绕，<NL>与此蛇妖枯黑双臂一道奔袭而来：<NL>“何方野人？安敢妄谈因果！”
9e5adf57-fd50-4ea9-b25f-fb3e9c722af2/Eve.ru: Выражение лица лорда Блэкклэда потемнело.<NL>Яростная чудовищная Ци вырвалась из него, разливаясь по пещере подобно бушующему потоку Лун.<NL>В тот же миг эта змея бросилась вперед со своими иссохшими черными руками.<NL>"Что ты за дикарь такой, чтобы говорить мне о карме!"

9e5adf57-fd50-4ea9-b25f-fb3e9c722af2/Opt.en: (Engage) Karma always collects its debts. Let's see who stands at the end!
9e5adf57-fd50-4ea9-b25f-fb3e9c722af2/Opt.cn: （应战）报应不爽，且看谁胜谁负！
9e5adf57-fd50-4ea9-b25f-fb3e9c722af2/Opt.ru: Карма всегда собирает свои долги. Давайте посмотрим, кто останется в конце!

f7486376-0dab-48fe-9bda-611c3d8267f6/Eve.en: Lord Blackclad froze at the words, then bared his teeth in a cold sneer.<NL>His sinister Monstrous Qi suddenly condensed into a sharp, focused edge, humming as the black snake coiled.<NL>"Come then! Let me see just how interesting you truly are!"
f7486376-0dab-48fe-9bda-611c3d8267f6/Eve.cn: 玄甲大王闻言一怔，随即呲牙冷笑，<NL>阴狂妖气猝然内收，凝实如锋，为此黑蛇挥动作响：<NL>“来啊！且让本王瞧瞧，你是何等‘有趣’！”
f7486376-0dab-48fe-9bda-611c3d8267f6/Eve.ru: Лорд Блэкклед застыл при этих словах, затем обнажил зубы в холодной усмешке.<NL>Его зловещая чудовищная Ци внезапно сгустилась в острый, сфокусированный край, жужжа, когда черная змея свернулась кольцом.<NL>- Тогда пойдем! Дай мне посмотреть, насколько ты на самом деле интересен!"

f7486376-0dab-48fe-9bda-611c3d8267f6/Opt.en: (Assault) Such arrogance! Watch your tongue before you lose your life!
f7486376-0dab-48fe-9bda-611c3d8267f6/Opt.cn: （突袭）大言不惭，当心丢了小命！
f7486376-0dab-48fe-9bda-611c3d8267f6/Opt.ru: (Нападение) Какое высокомерие! Следи за своим языком, пока не лишился жизни!

eee4debb-5c00-45f6-b6f8-268584697959/Eve.en: Lord Blackclad flew into a rage, shrieking as he lunged forward.<NL>Thousands of bizarre Monstrous Qi transformed into twisted weapons, attacking alongside him.<NL>"Die! All of you!"
eee4debb-5c00-45f6-b6f8-268584697959/Eve.cn: 玄甲大王暴跳如雷，咿呀怪叫着飞扑而来，<NL>千百诡谲妖气自化作各式各样的奇怪兵刃，随玄甲大王一同杀来：<NL>“死！都给我死！”
eee4debb-5c00-45f6-b6f8-268584697959/Eve.ru: Лорд Блэкклед пришел в ярость и с визгом бросился вперед.<NL>Тысячи причудливых чудовищных Ци, превратившихся в искривленное оружие, атаковали рядом с ним.<NL>- Умри! Все вы!"

eee4debb-5c00-45f6-b6f8-268584697959/Opt.en: (Fight) The only one dying here is you!
eee4debb-5c00-45f6-b6f8-268584697959/Opt.ru: (Драка) Единственный, кто здесь умирает, - это ты!

b05d660d-258c-4753-b7d1-53db6a77d62b/Eve.en: "Reverse the flow of Monstrous Qi! Invert the array!<NL>Transfer our power to the warrior!"<NL>The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey was the first to regain clarity, shouting urgently.<NL>The monsters startled, then quickly understood and responded in unison.<NL><NL>The spiritual Qi in the array suddenly lurched to a halt, then spiraled upward,<NL>carrying turbid, chaotic essence mingled with solidified, fierce power.<NL>It was swift as lightning, hurtling toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
b05d660d-258c-4753-b7d1-53db6a77d62b/Eve.cn: “逆运妖气！倒转大阵！<NL>将吾等妖气渡与壮士！”<NL>人面灵猴依旧率先清醒过来，旋即疾声狂呼，<NL>群妖闻言一惊，皆已明悟，纷纷响应，<NL><NL>阵中灵气猝而一滞，旋即飞旋直上，<NL>带起浑浊杂驳之气，携同凝实刚烈之气，<NL>迅驰如电，投<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>而来……

db087601-1459-422a-a18c-1fa904f3d876/Eve.en: Heavenly Qi was flawless, pure, and profound.<NL>Earthly Qi was rich, vast, and abundant.<NL>Human Qi was ever-changing, lively, and agile.<NL>Monstrous Qi was bizarre, rampant, and sinister.<NL>Righteous Qi was majestic, strong, and valiant.<NL><NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Lord Blackclad locked in a stalemate,<NL>the Five Qi flowed into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>blending seamlessly like water and milk, absorbed instantly without any visible reaction.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was slightly puzzled...
db087601-1459-422a-a18c-1fa904f3d876/Eve.cn: 天气无暇，清幽玄渺，<NL>地气浑厚，浩然洪泽，<NL>人气千变，活泛灵动，<NL>妖气诡谲，肆狂执凶，<NL>正气威赫，刚强勇烈，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正与玄甲大王斗得胜负难分之际，<NL>五气已源源不绝归于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>周身，<NL>竟似水乳交融，瞬间将五气纳于怀中，却不见丝毫动静，<NL>令<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>略感惊疑……

206bf840-3846-409f-ba33-c676be495e22/Eve.en: The Human-Faced Nimble Monkey remained focused on reversing the flow of the Demonsbane Array.<NL>Body tense, eyes strained, he responded with difficulty,<NL>"Our actions brought this calamity! Since the warrior stood up for us, we must assist with all our might...<NL><NL>Monstrous Qi is inherently chaotic, unsettled energy between heaven, earth, and mortal realms...<NL>The warrior must possess some artifact as proof...<NL>Otherwise, how could we have dreamed of this place...<NL>How could we... have found this place..."
206bf840-3846-409f-ba33-c676be495e22/Eve.cn: 人面灵猴全力引导逆运绝魔大阵，<NL>此刻早已浑身紧绷，双目欲裂，闻言艰难应道：<NL>“吾等所为致祸！壮士为吾等挺身，吾等自当竭力而助……<NL><NL>妖气本就为天地凡尘间浑沌未定之气……<NL>壮士身上，定有物什为凭……<NL>否则，如何梦见此处……<NL>如何……寻得此地……”

dcadf57f-b288-418f-b432-d69f64089314/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was momentarily distracted, slowing down.<NL>Lord Blackclad's monstrous eyes flashed crimson, seizing the opening to launch an assault.<NL>He opened his bloody maw wide, inhaling wildly to devour the Five Qi for himself.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> barely managed to parry his claws.<NL>As Lord Blackclad's vicious fangs closed in on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s neck,<NL>a scorching energy surged within...
dcadf57f-b288-418f-b432-d69f64089314/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一时分神，动作不由慢了几分，<NL>玄甲大王妖目顿闪赤光，趁机猛攻，<NL>顺势大张血口狂吸，欲吞食五气，为己所用，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>堪堪隔开其爪，<NL>眼见玄甲大王的凶利尖齿已近在颈侧，<NL>忽觉怀中似有滚烫翻涌……

5130db9d-ce34-4fc1-8bff-6ca9cf647819/Eve.en: At the critical moment, a brilliant light flashes, extending and recoiling to knock the serpent demon's fangs aside.<NL>The cavern falls into sudden silence; the demons freeze in shock.<NL>Three morphings emerge from the Bead of Desire, drifting like smoke and shadows.<NL>Nourished by the Trinity energy, the demon aura transformed, stabilizing the righteous energy.<NL>The morphings strengthen slightly and together block the Lord Blackclad.<NL><NL>The Blackscale Serpent, terrified, sees its fierce gaze falter.<NL>Its body suddenly expands, armor plates shatter, and it retreats in a blur...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(The Bead of Desire absorbed abundant Trinity Energy, now able to summon three morphings to assist in battle...)</color>
5130db9d-ce34-4fc1-8bff-6ca9cf647819/Eve.cn: 千钧一发之际，华光骤现，一伸一卷即刻将蛇妖之牙生生弹开，<NL>洞窟内霎时鸦雀无声，群妖亦是瞠目结舌，<NL>却见三道化身自化念珠中聚出，如烟如影飘渺不定，<NL>竟是三才之气滋养，妖气转化，正气稳固，<NL>不觉已助三道化身略复几分，齐齐现出，挡开玄甲大王，<NL><NL>那黑鳞蛇妖见状惊惧不已，目中凶光也变得飘忽不定，<NL>它的身形骤然暴涨，其身上的甲胄片片折断，化作黑影急步后撤……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（化念珠吸纳诸多三才之气，已可唤出三道化身同时助战……）</color>

57469d4b-cae1-4971-8e0e-525a3906a845/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> possessed peerless martial arts, supported by three incarnations.<NL>Though Lord Blackclad employed every desperate trick, he couldn't withstand <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s relentless assault.<NL>His dark Monstrous Qi faltered, scales and armor shattered, and shadowy form began to fade away.<NL>He was utterly powerless, unable to resist.<NL><NL>Yet, this snake would not submit. Seeing his defeat was inevitable, Lord Blackclad threw back his head and let out a roar.<NL>He dissolved his body and scattered his soul violently,<NL>hoping to escape amid the chaos...
57469d4b-cae1-4971-8e0e-525a3906a845/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>武功盖世，又有三道化身相助，<NL>任是玄甲大王百般手段齐出，也无法抵挡<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的攻势，<NL>玄甲大王的玄黑妖气渐衰，暗鳞甲胄渐残，墨阴身形渐散，<NL>已是无力相抗，再难挣扎，<NL><NL>然而此妖妖性顽固，见败局已定，玄甲大王仰天长啸，<NL>愤然兵解躯窍，胡乱横散神魂，<NL>妄图趁乱逃出一命……

345a3ed4-b16f-4982-8dee-3f49f6f6b36a/Eve.en: Lord Blackclad possessed vast battle experience and millennia of cultivation.<NL>Even though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> received the aid of three incarnations, they could barely match this ancient monster.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s battle momentum gradually waned, injuries mounting.<NL>Finally, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> could endure no longer and collapsed into a pool of blood,<NL>leaving the three incarnations locked in a stalemate with Lord Blackclad.<NL>Even as the horde of monsters channeled the Five Qi to help, it was all in vain...
345a3ed4-b16f-4982-8dee-3f49f6f6b36a/Eve.cn: 玄甲大王久经战阵，更有百年修炼阅历，<NL>纵是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>有三道化身助，也难与此妖一较高下，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>战势渐败，伤势渐重，<NL>已是支撑不住，倒入血泊之中，<NL>徒留三道化身与玄甲大王僵持不下，<NL>纵是群妖依旧拼尽全力不断渡来五气，仍旧无济于事……

345a3ed4-b16f-4982-8dee-3f49f6f6b36a/Opt.ru: (Я не должен отступать... Я не могу...)

e260e892-40a7-4598-b3df-46102ebd6f85/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> leapt in pursuit.<NL>Suddenly, an object flew out from within the robes.<NL>Round, smooth, and lustrous like jade, colorful and shimmering like a treasure.<NL>It was the Eldritch Orb from Mount Emei!<NL><NL>The Eldritch Orb rose above <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s head, circling in orbit, its light blazing brilliantly.<NL>All the scattered Monstrous Qi, souls, and remnants in the cave were held fast and drawn toward it.<NL>Wherever the radiant light spread, dark shadows vanished.<NL>Then the orb split into three segments, infusing the Qi of Cosmic Trinity into the three incarnations...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> lost the Eldritch Orb.)</color>
e260e892-40a7-4598-b3df-46102ebd6f85/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>纵身追去，<NL>忽有一物自怀中飞旋而出，<NL>圆溜温润光泽如玉，异彩玲珑披霞如宝，<NL>却是自峨眉所得之妖仙珠！<NL><NL>妖仙珠飞临<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>头顶，孑然盘桓，光芒大盛，<NL>洞中散乱妖气妖魂，妖躯妖骨，<NL>皆困顿不前，尽为之所收，华光遍处，再无黑玄，<NL>却又裂作三瓣，分出浩然三才之气，投入三道化身之中……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>失去妖仙珠……）</color>

e260e892-40a7-4598-b3df-46102ebd6f85/Opt.en: Their fusion unexpectedly transmuted the Monstrous Qi into the Qi of Cosmic Trinity...
e260e892-40a7-4598-b3df-46102ebd6f85/Opt.cn: 妖物相合，竟然将妖气逆化为三才之气……
e260e892-40a7-4598-b3df-46102ebd6f85/Opt.ru: Их слияние неожиданно преобразовало Чудовищную Ци в Ци Космической Троицы...

4a60a8de-89be-4b64-9974-d155ce46bb7e/Eve.en: As the three incarnations solidified,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> quickly turned back to find the monsters who had helped.<NL><NL>However, the array in the cave was already broken, and the monsters had lost all their power.<NL>At this moment, they lay sprawled across the ground in disarray,<NL>barely clinging to life...
4a60a8de-89be-4b64-9974-d155ce46bb7e/Eve.cn: 眼见三道化身正愈发凝实，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>赶忙回身寻找方才襄助的群妖，<NL><NL>洞中阵法却是已破，群妖亦是妖力尽失，<NL>此刻群妖已经横七竖八地瘫倒在地，<NL>仅是强撑着苟延残喘……

b7ee972f-7e48-435b-9028-61bc280f0443/Eve.en: Seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> rush over, the Human-Faced Nimble Monkey managed a weak smile.<NL>"Good...! Cough... <NL>Warrior... you are truly a peerless hero..."<NL><NL>Heart clenching, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> urgently asked the three incarnations without looking back...
b7ee972f-7e48-435b-9028-61bc280f0443/Eve.cn: 眼见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>奔来，人面灵猴艰难笑道：<NL>“好……好！咳咳……<NL>壮士……真乃盖世英杰……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下一紧，不等回头便急急问向三道化身……
b7ee972f-7e48-435b-9028-61bc280f0443/Eve.ru: Видя <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> подбежав, Проворная обезьяна с человеческим лицом выдавила слабую улыбку.<NL>"Хорошо...! Кашель... <NL>Воин... ты действительно несравненный герой..."<NL><NL>Сердце сжимается, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> - настойчиво спросили три воплощения, не оглядываясь назад...

b7ee972f-7e48-435b-9028-61bc280f0443/Opt.en: Honored ones, is there any way to save them?
b7ee972f-7e48-435b-9028-61bc280f0443/Opt.cn: 三位，可有什么办法能救他们！
b7ee972f-7e48-435b-9028-61bc280f0443/Opt.ru: Почтенные, есть ли какой-нибудь способ спасти их?

958ef923-a406-4ad4-bb27-a52e892a70a1/Eve.en: "Their strength is spent, yet their essence remains intact."<NL><NL>"Nourished by the earth, their lives are not in danger..."<NL><NL>"However, their Monstrous Qi is exhausted after aiding us.
